resolves.name: Carrier::GetSelected
resolves.pattern: 55 8B EC 51 89 4D FC 8B 45 FC 8B 40 30 8B E5 5D C3 CC CC CC CC
resolves.identity: Carrier selected-mask getter called by Person::Simulate at 0x0059D76C in exact GOG Redux 2.2.301. The function is the complete 17-byte thiscall leaf that returns [this+0x30]. Five lcbench pilot-ordering dumps fault at its mov eax,[eax+0x30] when Person+0x1A0 is null; the caller independently identifies the selected-mask use before the five-slot SNIP scan.

resolves.name: Team::EnemyP(int)
resolves.identity: Team::EnemyP(int targetTeam) on exact GOG Redux 2.2.301. The complete thiscall body rejects targetTeam<=0, otherwise tests 1<<targetTeam against this+0x17C and returns with ret 4. GameObject::EnemyP at 0x004DB600 calls it, and the independently reconstructed ControlPanel::Render target-list call at 0x004A3FD6 supplies each candidate object's virtual GetTeamNum result before inserting at most ten attack targets.

resolves.name: PREREQ_WhatIs
resolves.identity: PREREQ_WhatIs(const char* name) on exact GOG Redux 2.2.301, the AI's only ODF-name-to-prereq-id lookup. The body linearly walks PREREQ_table (0x9C-byte entries; kind byte at +0, type pointer at +4) up to PREREQ_maxassigned, strncmp'ing the argument against the type's name at +0x14 for a unit or +0x40 for a building, and returns 0 on no match. AIP_Load_Account at 0x00693520 calls it once per construction-program item at 0x00693872 and discards the node when it returns 0, logging 'UNKOWN UNIT OR BUILDING TYPE' (string 0x00893EB4) - the one xref that independently identifies the call site. Matches 1.5's PREREQ_WhatIs at 0x00515466 instruction for instruction.

resolves.name: AI FindObjectClass
resolves.identity: FindObjectClass(objClass, buildClass) on exact GOG Redux 2.2.301. Selects buildingClassList 0x0260AFD0 or vehicleClassList 0x0260AF90 by IsBuilding, then walks it comparing ONLY the built class, filling in the entry's build class when it is still null. AddObjectClass at 0x006A2200 calls it once at its own prologue as the duplicate guard, which is the sole call site.

resolves.name: AI Units_Init
resolves.identity: Units_Init on exact GOG Redux 2.2.301. Seeds both class-list pointers, stores vehicleClassList's size into NRUNITTYPES 0x02C00ABC, assigns each unittypeid, then iterates both lists calling GetPrereq 0x006A3D50 and SetMaker 0x006A3DB0 for every entry with a non-null build class. Called last from 0x006A1AC0, before PREREQ_Init 0x0069F030 runs from 0x006A1AF0.

resolves.name: AI IsBuilding
resolves.identity: IsBuilding(GameObjectClass*) on exact GOG Redux 2.2.301, cdecl with the class in the single stack argument. Returns true for class_id 2 with a non-negative +0x13C, for the 'TURR' signature, and otherwise defers to BuildingVehicle 0x006A07E0. Both GetPrereq and SetMaker open with this same call to choose between the unit and building type structs.

resolves.name: AI Class2UnitType
resolves.identity: Class2UnitType(GameObjectClass*) on exact GOG Redux 2.2.301. Fetches the per-class UnitTypeAttachment through the attachment slot 0x02C00EC0, constructing it on first use, and returns base+4. SetMaker 0x006A3DB0 writes makers[0] at +0x66 of this return, and PREREQ_Init reads side at +0x58, prereqtype at +0x5A, prereqs at +0x5E and makers at +0x66 from the same pointer.

resolves.name: AI Class2BuildingType
resolves.identity: Class2BuildingType(GameObjectClass*, 0) on exact GOG Redux 2.2.301, the building counterpart of Class2UnitType through the same attachment slot 0x02C00EC0. SetMaker writes makers[0] at +0x16 of its return, and PREREQ_Init's building branch reads prereqtype at +0x00, equivalence at +0x0C, prereqs at +0x0E and makers at +0x16 of the same 0x80-byte struct.

resolves.name: AI GetPrereq
resolves.identity: GetPrereq(GameObjectClass*) on exact GOG Redux 2.2.301. Branches on IsBuilding 0x006A0810 and returns the prereqtype ushort, at +0x00 of the building type or +0x5A of the unit type. Units_Init 0x006A3E20 pairs it with SetMaker 0x006A3DB0; distinguished from SetMaker, whose prologue differs only in its 0x08 frame and 74 27 branch, by the 0x0C frame and 74 1C here.

resolves.name: CalcRange(Craft)
resolves.identity: CalcRange(Craft*, &close, &range, &time, &weapon) at 0x00466BE0 on the exact GOG 2.2.301 baseline. UnitTask::Execute 0x006002A0 supplies its craft and five output addresses; the decompile initializes close/range/time/weapon, scans the craft's selected weapon slots through CalcRange(Weapon) 0x00466890, selects the largest usable weapon range, and subtracts 1.0. Cross-checked in reverse_engineering/backlog_address_audit_20260708.md; the signature is the function entry and matched once in SHA-256 8d71f56c1314e69a8ad38f4eeaf20a8ff825965a84cf196e5f77ea4cc3377413.

resolves.name: Workshop::GetManager
resolves.identity: The unique anchor is cUI_Mods::RefreshWorkshop at 0x00795B80, called by the New Game Mods RefreshButton path 0x00794710 -> 0x00795BA0. Ghidra decompilation shows its first CALL at 0x00795B87 targets 0x00764790, which returns DAT_00945478, the active cWorkshopSteam/cWorkshopGoG singleton; mov ecx,eax then passes that same object to the Workshop resource refresh at 0x0076C0F0. The Steam vtable at 0x0089D054 independently identifies slot 1 as 0x00773D80 (GetItemState/DownloadItem) and slot 3 as 0x00773C40 (not ready while NeedsUpdate/Downloading/DownloadPending). Settled native runtime capture on Steam SHA-256 D298782FC9A13EDB0665DB934110440C45461031DB5F7FE1A76C8784B61CC90D, PID 10928 on 2026-08-28, read identical bytes at 0x00764790 and the full anchor at 0x00795B80; the pattern matched once in the GOG static image SHA-256 8D71F56C1314E69A8AD38F4EEAF20A8FF825965A84CF196E5F77EA4CC3377413.

resolves.name: Terrain::GetManager
resolves.identity: Released cRenderableTileClusterManager singleton getter at 0x0077C670. The body tests DAT_0094549C, allocates exactly 0x88 bytes when absent, calls the independently decompiled manager constructor FUN_0077A650, stores the result back to DAT_0094549C, and returns that singleton. Terrain mesh creation/population functions FUN_007778B0, FUN_007789A0, and FUN_00779C20 all call it; the pattern anchors the function entry through the singleton-null test and distinctive 0x88 allocation.

resolves.name: Terrain::GetFloat
resolves.identity: Released TRN/INI float getter at 0x00787B60. FUN_00780160 and the terrain lighting/height readers pass section, key, float fallback, and current TRN filename; the body copies the fallback, rejects empty strings, normalizes/loads the named file through FUN_00787370, retrieves a 16-byte value through FUN_00787660, parses it with the unique percent-f sscanf path, and returns the float in ST0. The signature anchors the entry and its four-argument validation prelude.

resolves.name: MPVehicleList::LoadCallSiteNetveh
resolves.identity: The `call FUN_00766900` that loads the default multiplayer starting-vehicle pool "netveh.odf", inside cUI_Multiplayer_Create (FUN_00796880) on exact GOG Redux 2.2.301. Anchored on the CALL, not its operand. The pattern covers the exception-state store `mov byte [ebp-4],0x22`, the `lea ecx,[ebp-0x70] / push ecx` that passes the pool-name std::string, and the `call FUN_00764780 / mov ecx,eax` that fetches the list singleton DAT_0094548C immediately before. Identity is settled at install time by requiring this site and MPVehicleList::LoadCallSiteMission to resolve to one and the same loader; FUN_00766900 has exactly these two callers in the image.

resolves.name: MPVehicleList::LoadCallSiteMission
resolves.identity: The `call FUN_00766900` that loads the map-supplied starting-vehicle pool `<mission>.vxt`, inside FUN_007A3E60 on exact GOG Redux 2.2.301. FUN_007A3E60 rewrites the mission filename's last four characters to ".vxt" and loads it; FUN_00766900 falls back to "netveh.odf" when that file is absent, so this call site is where host/map pool authority enters. Anchored on the CALL; the trailing `mov edx,[ebp-0x2C] / mov dword [edx+0x38],-1` selection reset distinguishes it from the netveh site.
